_comment: Blelloch wait-free prefix-sum sort — Phase 1 local-histogram pass on 8K u32 keys, radix bit_offset=0 (first 4-bit pass). Pipeline layout:'auto' on entry_point=local_histogram_pass binds only the 5 declarations the function uses (params, keys_in, keys_out, block_histograms, block_offsets). SortParams (4 u32: element_count, bit_offset, block_count, _pad) shimmed via uniform-u32-tuple. block_count = ceil(8192/256) = 32, so per-block histograms sized 32 * RADIX_SIZE(16) * 4 = 2048 bytes.
section: Auxiliary sort kernel (radix prefix-sum) — characterization on a wait-free Blelloch scan that replaces spin-wait radix on WebGPU; cited as the deadlock-free alternative for cross-vendor portability (Apple/Intel/NVIDIA/AMD/Adreno).
